name: Balance pass: the harder tiers on one blow dial. Dangerous pull 5 and Deadly pull 8 both hit 2.5 times Normal
why: The base dials (1.17 and 1.33) do not bite a party: on all 28 ground ends a MID four on Deadly sits at 72 to 97% health with no death (run 44920906999). The death sample (run 44925664434, 4 seeds of 8 hours) read Deadly at 2.25 and 2.5 and Dangerous at 2.6 and 3.0. At 2.5 Deadly bites at 10 of 14 band floors and is safe at 13 of 14 band tops. Dangerous takes the same blows on its smaller pull, so the tiers can never invert on a ground with shooters. Layer: coefficient, TIER_DIALS, one table for every ground.
